'''Riin Raas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who served with the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]]. He was imbedded on [[Kirima (Kalinda system)|Kirima]], operating undercover as a [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Surveillance (Imperial Security Bureau)/Legends|Surveillance]] agent.
